cooperative-green.$description: Cooperative Green — Hero panel fill, primary stat block, decorative dot overlays — the loudest brand voice; the color that makes the page feel activated

civic-blue.$description: Civic Blue — News card surfaces, secondary stat blocks — chromatic but cooler, reserved for media/content contexts rather than primary brand expression

sunset-coral.$description: Sunset Coral — Accent stat block only — appears once as data emphasis, treated as a single-note punctuation rather than a system color

mint-whisper.$description: Mint Whisper — Card and nav surface tint — a barely-there green echo of the hero green, softens white space without breaking the light theme

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, pill button fill, all borders and dividers — does the structural work of the system, the only color used for controls

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, text on filled buttons, image surfaces

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Muted helper text, secondary nav borders — the only mid-gray in the system, used sparingly for de-emphasis

athletics.$description: Display and badge type — used for hero headlines (48–78px), card labels, and uppercase tags. The wide letter-spacing (0.04em) is a French institutional signature that turns every headline into a civic declaration. Custom face; substitute with Archivo Black, Anton, or Druk for similar uppercase weight and tracking, or with a wide-tracked geometric like Bebas Neue for closer feel.

manrope.$description: Body, navigation, button labels, and small text — the working font. Slightly opened tracking (0.01–0.011em) is a subtle departure from default; it keeps dense French text feeling breathable without becoming display-like. Pairs cleanly with Athletics because both share geometric, humanist proportions.
